2.  Rand's Pipe - Brandon Sanderson has stated that one of the secrets he is not allowed to divulge is how Rand lit his pipe.  But we can offer a conjecture.  Consider carefully that he did not use the power.  He reached out to [[Saidin]] but felt nothing.  And the True Power was just as inaccessible.  So what did he do?  He THOUGHT about the pipe being lit - and it was.  Rand basically willed reality.  The implications within this possibility space are staggering.  What we witness here is Rand demonstrating powers of the Creator.  And how did this come about?  Maybe one day Brandon will tell us.  But I have a suspicion that it won't happen so long as [[Harriet Rigney]] is alive.

It should also be noted that Rand isn't the only being to will reality within the series.  The Eelfinn were able to will memories into Mat's mind.  I believe the Finn - as 4th dimensional beings -  exist outside the pattern.  This means they are not subjected to it nor are they controlled by it.  i.e. they have no threads within it.  I further believe that Rand has transcended to this level somehow and that since he is also outside the pattern, he can play with threads too.  Thus - he lit his pipe.
